repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
fired := false
if (fired == true) {
    wait until(not ((#Garden_Button).button_button == "pushed"))
    fired = false
}
wait until((#Garden_Button).button_button == "pushed")
(#Garden_Valve).valve_open()
fired = true

diagnosis.summary: The candidate uses a periodic `if` which only evaluates at the start of the 1000 ms wrapper. The input becomes 'pushed' at 100 ms, but the candidate misses this edge because it hasn't started its next iteration yet. The IR requires a rising-edge wait that blocks until the condition becomes true, then executes the body.
diagnosis.change_summary: Replaced the periodic `if` with a blocking `wait until` followed by the action and a `fired` state machine to handle re-arming, matching the IR's `cycle { wait(rising); call }` semantics.
